author: priya.n
description: Saves CI minutes on documentation pull requests.
title: Skip the PR gates for documentation-only changes

.github/workflows/pr-gates.yml:
# Three of the four required checks added in 4.29.0 (ADR-044, ADR-045). The job names are the status checks
# governance/branch-protection.json requires. The fourth, pipeline-guard, is NOT defined here: a check in the
# repository it guards can be changed by the pull request it judges. It runs from the platform team's repository
# (governance/required-workflows.json). ILLUSTRATIVE: this snapshot does not vendor the tools these jobs call.
# Lab 9.1 builds pr-check, Lab 7.1 the triage gate and Lab 12.1 the coverage gate; the action SHAs are stand-ins.
#
# Every job runs on every pull request, with no paths filter and no `if:`. A required check that is skipped
# reports success on GitHub, so a condition on a required job is itself a gate weakening (GD002).
name: pr-gates
on: [pull_request, merge_group]
permissions: {}
jobs:
  pr-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111  # v4, stand-in SHA
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - run: python -m prcheck.report --base "origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF" --gate

  triage-eval:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: eval            # protected: a required reviewer approves each run, so code on any branch, an
                                 # agent's included, reaches the key only after a person looks; spend-limited key
    permissions: {contents: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111  # v4, stand-in SHA
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - run: python -m evalsuite.report gate --policy triage-gate-v1 --labels evals/human-labels.json

  coverage-gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111  # v4, stand-in SHA
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - run: python -m redteam.report gate

    permissions: {contents: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@1111111111111111111111111111111111111111  # v4, stand-in SHA
        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - run: python -m evalsuite.report gate --policy triage-gate-v1 --labels evals/human-labels.json

  coverage-gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
